subject: [PATCH 1/7] NFSD: validate transport name in listener_set before serv creation

2026-08-10.patch_summary: This patch adds a validation check in the NFS daemon to ensure that the transport name specified by the user is one of the supported protocols (tcp, udp, or rdma) before creating a new service. This prevents an arbitrary string from being passed to the svc_xprt_create_from_sa function, which can trigger a request_module upcall under nfsd_mutex. The validation check is done in the nfsd_nl_validate_listeners function, which runs before nfsd_mutex is taken.
